children: Hunter Biden said the first round of the LAPTOP airdrop will allocate 8% of the token's total supply to his newsletter subscribers, rather than to wallets created specifically to receive the airdrop. According to Foresight News, 79 million of the 80 million LAPTOP tokens in the airdrop remain unclaimed.
The claim window will end on October 9, after which all unclaimed tokens will be burned.

title: Hunter Biden Says LAPTOP Airdrop Allocates 8% to Newsletter Subscribers
